audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls Volibear's stun 'his E stun' and wants.foe[0] names it 'E hand-of-the-god stun'. Both are wrong: the stun is Thundering Smash (Q); Sky Splitter (E) is a 1200-range lightning bolt that slows and shields him. 'Hand of the god' is not an ability in this kit at all.
audit.why: enemyKit Q carries hardCC and autoReset at 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and 300 range; enemyKit E carries projectile, slow, shield, zone at 1200 range on a flat 16s. Advice built on 'dodge his E stun' sends the reader to dodge the wrong ability at the wrong range.
audit.corrected: Thundering Smash (Q) is the 12s gap-closer, stun and auto reset — and, being hard CC, it cancels Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines channel. Sky Splitter (E) is the 1200-range slow that shields him if he stands in his own bolt.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Quinn Level 1 and 2+ items and marked everything between as Skill, which is backwards at both ends.
audit.why: 56.5% over 200 games; packet chart is Quinn rows 0-5 and Volibear row 6. The prose already says levels 1-3 are pure value, that you stay ahead through 4-6, and that two items is where it flips.
audit.corrected: Quinn rows 0-5, Volibear row 6, both layers.

audit.why: Spike ladder is right: Quinn owns Lvl 1-3, R is roam tempo at 6, first item is the last clean all-in, and Volibear takes over on HP and resistances at 2+ items. Stormbringer at 160s rank 1 is a rare button, so it does not create a lane spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block named Thundering Smash without a number and never mentioned Sky Splitter.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1 and Sky Splitter is a flat 16s at every rank — those two numbers are the whole trading rhythm.

Frenzied Maul applies on-hit effects and The Relentless Storm stacks attack speed, so his damage scales with attack speed rather than raw AD — Plated Steelcaps plus early Executioner's, already in the item line, is the correct answer.
sources: enemyKit P and W onHit/heal flags

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d under 'Extend into his W heal' was template filler about burning your own cooldown.
audit.why: It never mentions Frenzied Maul or healing.
audit.corrected: Frenzied Maul heals on every second cast — anti-heal before you commit.
sources: enemyKit W text and heal flag

edits.before: You stay ahead through levels 4-6 as long as you respect his E. The danger trade is his Q empowered dash into W bite heal plus E stun — dodge the dash with your own E Vault, which also refreshes Harrier and slows him. At 6 your R is roam pressure, not duel burst, so take your lane lead and pressure side lanes while he is stuck farming. Keep poking him off plates; his only kill threat is a clean E onto you.
edits.after: You stay ahead through levels 4-6 as long as you respect Thundering Smash (Q): 12s at rank 1, it stuns, it is an auto reset, and it cancels your R channel. Sky Splitter (E) is a 1200-range bolt that slows you and shields him if he stands in the circle, so never walk into it. At 6 your R is roam pressure, not duel burst — shove, leave, and poke him off plates while Q is down.

edits.before: This is where it flips. Once Volibear stacks HP and resistances his W bite heal and percent-damage brawl shrug off your autos, and a single E stun deletes you since you are squishy with no escape beyond E Vault. Your blind only stops his autos, not his ability damage, so a fed Voli runs you down. Close the game on your early lead and roam — if it goes late and even, he wins the 1v1 and the teamfight.
edits.after: This is where it flips. Once Volibear stacks HP and resistances, Frenzied Maul heals him back every 5 seconds and one Thundering Smash stun deletes you — you are squishy with no escape but Vault. Your blind stops his autos, not Sky Splitter or Stormbringer, so buy Executioner's before the brawl and a fed Voli still runs you down. Close on your early lead — late and even, he wins the 1v1 and the fight.
